title: Spidey and his amazing friends.
lines: Three friends live in a big city.
Peter, Miles and Gwen.
They're still young, but they're real heroes.
Peter is Spidey.
He has a red and blue suit.
Miles is Spin.
He has a black and red suit.
And Gwen is Ghost-Spider.
Her suit is white and pink.
All three of them can climb up walls.
And they can shoot webs from their wrists.
Thwip!
Their base is a secret place.
Their little robots live there too.
Trace-E is the little robot who can find anything.
One morning it's zoo day.
The children go to the zoo.
They see lions, giraffes and penguins.
But then they hear an alarm.
Beep, beep, beep!
The monkeys have escaped!
A naughty man opened the cage.
He wants to steal the zoo's bananas.
The monkeys run through the city.
One is sitting on a lamppost.
One is sitting in an ice cream van.
And one is climbing a tall tower.
Time to help, shouts Spidey.
Spidey team, go!
Ghost-Spider is the fastest.
She swings on her web from building to building.
She catches the monkey on the lamppost.
Spin has a special power.
He can become invisible.
He creeps up to the ice cream van.
The monkey doesn't notice.
Gotcha, Spin has him.
Spidey climbs the tall tower.
He feels a tingle in his head.
That's his spider-sense.
It warns him of danger.
The tower wobbles.
Spidey quickly shoots a web.
He makes a net.
That's how he catches the last monkey.
Then they see the naughty man.
He's running away with a big bag of bananas.
The three friends all shoot a web at the same time.
Thwip, thwip, thwip!
The man is stuck in a big sticky web.
The monkeys go back to the zoo.
They get their bananas back.
The zookeeper is so happy.
How can I thank you?
Spidey laughs.
Can we see the penguins again?
Together they watch the penguins sliding down a slide.
Because together they're the strongest.
The end.
